name: recall
description: Makes past sessions recallable: indexes Claude Code and Codex transcripts, subagent runs, memory files, standing orders and second-opinion reviews into a local SQLite index (kept after Claude Code deletes old transcripts), gives Claude search, expand, recap and list tools, and adds /recall (search, last session, timeline, decisions, commands, files, PRs, ask), /remember, a pick-up-where-you-left-off band and a related-work band. Nothing calls a model except /recall ask: one call to the ask model per question, billed to your usage.

dbPath.title: Index file
dbPath.description: Where the SQLite index is kept (~ is your home folder). It holds extracts of your past sessions, with known secret shapes masked.

python.title: Python
python.description: The python3 that runs the indexing engine (standard library only).

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Comma-separated sources to index: claude (Claude Code sessions), codex (Codex sessions), memory (memory files), orders (standing orders), reviews (second-opinion reviews).

includeSubagents.title: Index subagent transcripts
includeSubagents.description: Also index what subagents did inside a session.

includeRoutines.title: Include routine sessions
includeRoutines.description: Show scheduled (routine) sessions in search results, lists and the timeline. Off: they are indexed but left out unless a query asks for them (routines:include).

updateMinutes.title: Re-index every (minutes)
updateMinutes.description: How often new and changed sessions are indexed in the background while a session is open.

relatedBand.title: Related-work band
relatedBand.description: When your prompt names a PR or issue number, a ticket, a file or a quoted phrase that past sessions mention, show a band above the prompt with Show and Attach.

lastSessionBand.title: Last-session band
lastSessionBand.description: At the start of a session, show this project's last session (title, PR, open tasks) in a band with Recap.

maxResults.title: Results per search
maxResults.description: How many hits the search tool returns to Claude.

askModel.title: /recall ask model
askModel.description: The model that answers /recall ask from the excerpts it finds. Every /recall ask is one call to it, billed to your usage.
